Mango Flan
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 7:07pm

Ingredients




5 tablespoons Water
1 pkt Gelatin
2 lrgs Mangoes, diced
1 can Sweetened condensed milk
1 can ( same as the condensed milk) of water

Preparation

1 Here are ome recipes from a Brazilian cooking show that i've just translated for you. I haven't tried them all yet, but they looked real yummy:Place the mangoes and the 1 can measure of water in a blender and run the machine to make a thick juice.Stir in the condensed milk. Dissolve the gelatin in the 5 tbs water. Mix the dissolved gelatin with the mango cream. 2 Pour into a mold, chill 5 hours. Unmold and serve with a blueberry sauce.
